name: Arcana Department

shapes: continuous partyRestriction {role:'any', parity:'even', scope:'allParties'} -- a location that constrains EVERY forming attacking/blocking party (source is never a party member), rejected in declareAttack/declareBlockers

notes: partyRestriction today only bites parties that include the source; a location needs an all-parties scope. Shares the cap with Hangdog Alley (rogue).

name: Ashes of Zenobia

shapes: triggered:turnStarted (eventPlayerIs controller) -> draw 1
activated NULLIFY: costs [payResources 5] -> forEachPlayer -> chooserSelectsTarget {chooser:controller, {controller:self,type:character} count 1} -> moveCard hand

notes: NULLIFY: each player chooses which of their own characters is bounced.

name: Degenerate Molestation

shapes: behavior.noResponse
onPlay.targets [{opp:{type:faction, controller:opponent} 1}] (pick an opponent -> in 2p just the one)

effects: repeatUntil { condition: numberCompare(count{owner:opponent,zone:hand}, '=', 0), maxIterations: 20, effects: [ chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:{ownerOf opp}, {owner:opponent,zone:hand} count 1} -> bind x = {cardCost {selected discarded}} -> moveCard discard -> deployForFree {player:controller, maxCost:{variable x}, selector:{zone:hand, conditions:[not resource]}} ] }

notes: 'Repeat this card's effect until that player has no cards in their hand' = repeatUntil with a hard iteration cap. deployForFree is per-iteration optional. Concession: bind must capture X before the discard moves the card.

name: Ecto-Distillation

shapes: onPlay: nameValue {chooser:controller, valueKind:'cardName', storeAs:'named'}

effects: chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:controller, {owner:self,zone:deck, nameVar:'named'} count 1 optional} -> moveCard hand; forEach {selector:{owner:self,zone:deck,nameVar:'named'}} -> moveCard discard; shuffleDeck; chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:opponent, {owner:self,zone:deck,nameVar:'named'} count 20 optional} -> forEach moveCard discard; shuffleDeck

notes: 'any number of copies' modelled as a large optional count. 'reveal' is cosmetic. The opponent's optional counter-search puts the copies into the CASTER's discard (they're the deck owner).

shapes: keyword covert

triggered:turnStarted (eventPlayerIs controller) -> chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:controller, {controller:self, conditions:[not cardTypeIs resource]} count 1 optional} -> if(targetExists) addCounter token 1
triggered:cardEnteredPlay (sourceIsEventCard) -> addCounter source token 2
activated DISRUPT: costs [removeCounter source token 2] -> chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:opponent, {owner:opponent,zone:hand} count 1} -> moveCard discard

name: Lugubrian Octopod

shapes: keyword covert
triggered:damageDealt (and[sourceIsDamageSource, cardTypeIs {eventCard} faction]) -> chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:{ownerOf eventCard}, {owner:opponent,zone:hand} count 2} -> forEach moveCard discard

notes: 'that faction's controller' = ownerOf the faction card. count 2 collapses to hand size if smaller.

shapes: activated QUOTIDIAN INSTRUCTION: costs [deplete source] -> chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:controller, {owner:self,zone:deck,type:tactic} count 1 optional} -> moveCard hand; shuffleDeck

name: Nearby Serpent

shapes: keyword covert
triggered:cardEnteredPlay (sourceIsEventCard) -> chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:controller, {type:faction} count 1} -> lookAndReorder {player:{ownerOf selected}, chooser:controller, count:5}

notes: 'any one deck' = pick a faction card, reorder that owner's top 5. Same shape as Infatuated Armchair (1st Ed Part 2).

name: Quotidian Misfire

shapes: effect redirectHandMoves {who:'any', to:'discard', duration:{untilEndOfTurn}} -- a this-turn runtime window (like preventAllDamage / restrictDestruction): any card that would move to a hand from ANY zone goes to that owner's discard instead

notes: Today moveToZone replacements only fire on from==='play'; this needs a destination-side window for to==='hand' from any origin (incl. draw / discard-recur / bounce).

name: Ritual of the Shattering Teeth

shapes: onPlay: variables {x: player-chosen}, variableBounds x >=0, costs [payResources {multiply [{variable x}, 2]}]
effects: chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:controller, {owner:opponent,zone:hand} count {variable x} optional} -> forEach moveCard discard

notes: X+X = pay 2X. Caster looks at opponent hand and chooses (chooser:controller over an opponent-hand selector).

shapes: activated ENERGIZE: costs [deplete source], targets [{c:{controller:self, conditions:[not cardTypeIs resource]} count 1}] -> addCounter {selected c} token 1

name: Spastic Tentacles

shapes: triggered:cardEnteredPlay (sourceIsEventCard) -> forEachPlayer -> chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:controller, {controller:self, type:resource} count 1} -> moveCard hand

notes: Each player picks one of their own resources (face-down included) and returns it to hand (face-up).

shapes: triggered:turnStarted (eventPlayerIs controller) -> chooserSelectsOption [decline] / [addCounter source token 1]
activated ENERGIZE: costs [payResources 2] -> addCounter source token 1
activated DISSOLVE: condition numberCompare({modulo:[{count {type:character}}, 2]}, '=', 0), costs [removeCounter source token 4], targets [{c:{type:character} count 1}] -> destroy {selected c}

name: Voidal Poisoning

shapes: effect spendCountersMenu {chooser:controller, pool:{selector:{controller:self}}, counter:'token', options:[ {cost:1, label:'inflict 1 to a character', effects:[chooserSelectsTarget char -> dealDamage 1]}, {cost:2, label:'draw a card', effects:[draw 1]}, {cost:2, label:'an opponent discards a card', effects:[chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:opponent, opp hand, 1} -> moveCard discard]}, {cost:3, label:'search your deck for a card', effects:[chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:controller, {owner:self,zone:deck} 1} -> moveCard hand; shuffleDeck]} ]}

notes: 'remove any number of tokens from cards you control ... use the tokens ... any number of times' = a repeated token-budget menu (RULES.md §14 action loop). Removing tokens from which card is the player's choice as they spend.

name: Voidal Replication

shapes: behavior.noResponse
onPlay.condition: numberCompare({type:'deploysThisTurn', cardType:'tactic'}, '>=', 1) (a tactic has been deployed this turn, by anyone)
effects: duplicate {target:{lastDeployedTactic}} -- resolve the most-recently-resolved tactic's effects fresh under this card's controller

notes: The last tactic has already resolved (not on the stack) -> 'duplicate' must resolve it from its definition, choosing targets anew. Track GameState.lastDeployedTacticId at tactic resolution.

shapes: activated FORESIGHT: variables {x: player-chosen}, variableBounds x >=0, costs [payResources {variable x}] -> lookAndReorder {player:controller, count:{multiply [{variable x}, 2]}}

name: Bask Bile

shapes: onPlay.targets [{t:{conditions:[or(cardTypeIs character, cardTypeIs faction)]} count 1}]
effects: dealDamage {selected t} 5

notes: Damage to a faction converts to influence loss (CR §408.3, already handled).

name: Crazed Deputy

shapes: triggered:attackerBlocked (sourceIsEventCard) -> createModifier strength +2 untilEndOfTurn; createModifier life +2 untilEndOfTurn

notes: 'When this card is blocked' = attackerBlocked event (maps to the attacker).

name: Dragon Catheter

shapes: triggered:turnStarted (eventPlayerIs controller) -> chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:controller, {type:character, conditions:[isExtremum strength max among {type:character}]} count 1} -> addCounter token 1
continuous aura {selector:{type:character}, stat:strength, op:add, value:{counter __candidate token}}

notes: 'highest strength, ties: you decide' = isExtremum selector, mandatory count-1 pick collapses to the extrema.

name: Dragon Rider

shapes: continuous self: modifiers strength +{count {controller:self, subtype:'dragon'}}, life +{same}

notes: 'dragon card you control' — any type with the dragon subtype.

name: Dragon Tank

shapes: triggered:turnStarted (eventPlayerIs controller) -> chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:controller, {controller:opponent,type:character} count 1 optional} -> if(targetExists) destroy {selected}; else destroy source

notes: 'you may pick ... Otherwise, destroy this card' = optional pick, decline/none -> self-destruct.

name: Dragon's Quarters

shapes: triggered:turnStarted (eventPlayerIs controller) -> chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:controller, {type:character} count 1 optional} -> if(targetExists) dealDamage {selected} {add [{count {controller:self, subtype:'dragon'}}, 1]}

notes: 'this card inflicts' -> damage source is the location (source).

name: Flaming Barduse

shapes: onPlay.targets [{picked:{type:character} count 2 optional}]
onPlay.effects: if(targetExists {selected picked}) distributeAmong {chooser:controller, selected:'picked', amount:2, effects:[dealDamage __candidate {variable __amount}]}

notes: ETB inline in onPlay.effects so it can read the onPlay picks. 'up to 2 damage' -> distributeAmong amount 2 (chooser may assign less).

shapes: triggered:turnStarted (eventPlayerIs controller) -> chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:controller, {type:character} count 1 optional} -> if(targetExists) deplete {selected}

name: Humiliating Torture Apparatus

shapes: triggered:cardDepleted -> modifyInfluence {player:{controllerOf eventCard}, amount:-1}

notes: Resources attaching to a faction on use don't emit cardDepleted (matches the printed reminder text).

shapes: triggered:cardEnteredPlay (sourceIsEventCard) -> forEach {selector:{controller:opponent, type:character}} -> dealDamage __candidate 1

name: Reckless Challenger

shapes: triggered:turnEnding (eventPlayerIs controller) condition and[inPlaySinceTurnStart source, not {attackedThisTurn source}] -> destroy source

notes: GameState.attacksThisTurn already exists (attack-limit-per-turn); just need the read-side condition.

shapes: continuous aura {selector:{controller:self, type:character}, stat:strength, op:add, value:1}

name: Rudo Mangod

shapes: activated PUNCH: costs [payResources 2, deplete source], targets [{c:{type:character} count 1}] -> bind x = {stat {selected c} strength}; bind y = {stat source strength}; dealDamage source {variable x}; dealDamage {selected c} {variable y}

notes: bind X and Y before the damage so both read pre-damage strengths.

shapes: forEach {selector:{type:character}} -> dealDamage __candidate 2

name: Siege Machine

shapes: activated BATTERING RAM: targets [{r:{controller:self, type:resource} count 1}], costs [payResources 2, destroy {selected r}] -> modifyInfluence {player:opponent, amount:-1}

notes: 'An opponent's faction loses 1 influence' = modifyInfluence opponent -1.

name: Tactician Vacation

shapes: behavior.noResponse

effects: if(respondingTo {respondsTo:'card', cardType:'tactic'}) terminate {scope:'respondedItem'}; forEachPlayer -> restrictPlay {player:controller, kind:'cardType', cardType:'tactic', duration:{untilEndOfTurn}}

notes: 'This turn, tactics cannot be deployed' applied to every player via forEachPlayer + restrictPlay.
